FIELD GUIDE

THE CITY ANSWERS BACK.

  1. Choose a perspective.Five roles share one world. Switch at any time; earlier decisions remain.
  2. Make one decision per day.Read the trade-off. “Show effects” reveals direct and delayed changes. A decision commits the day.
  3. Read the ripple.Other actors respond. Blackouts, unsafe streets, corruption and alliances also affect the city.
  4. Advance and face the assembly.Tomorrow’s costs arrive before the next decision. After day six, the assembly assesses the whole record.

A fictional, rule-based prototype. Indicators use a 0–100 scale. Power is simulated grid coverage; livelihoods reflect trading conditions. The public reserve is measured in millions of naira. Place names are reversed; people’s names are not.

Assembly score: trust 30%, power 25%, livelihoods 20%, safety 15%, learning 10%. 65+ earns a mandate; 45–64 requires oversight; below 45 loses support. Your world saves in this browser only.
